verdict.rationale: Linear has a built-in Linear Agent that reads workspace context to do tasks: it drafts updates from recent changes and linked Slack messages, develops project ideas, and helps you understand your codebase. Asking questions of Linear data with answers is mainly evidenced through external tools such as the ChatGPT deep research connector and Claude/Cursor via the Linear MCP server. Missing for 10: a documented native Q&A experience in Linear, answers that cite workspace content, evidence of instant response, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
